szoveg_eredeti:
This episode was recorded at the WeAreDevelopers 2026 North American World Congress as part of their global event series for software engineers, tech leaders, and AI builders.

Romero Games is an independent game development studio based in Galway, Ireland, where John Romero serves as game director.

Learn more about John’s legendary game work at his website rome.ro.
